# ESS specification

Loom is specified in ESS. This page and the domain pages below are generated by `loom-docs` from two systems in the repository: `loom` in `ess/` and `intake` in `ess/intake/`. The graphs come from `ess specify compile`, the pages from `ess generate --kind docs`. They change when the specification changes, and `task check` fails if they fall behind it.

Commission's system, in `ess/commission/`, has its own reference: the [domain model](../commission/domain-model.mdx) and its [value types](../commission/types.mdx).

## Run

One model session executing a commission's run. Each catalogue is projected from one frontier; a selection names one action from that catalogue; arguments are generated for the selected action only. Loom never decides authority or completion.

<DomainGraph data={domainGraph0} title="Run" />

[Read the Run domain in full](./loom-run.md)

## confinement

Requested and observed confinement of local test commands. No automatic fallback.

<DomainGraph data={domainGraph1} title="confinement" />

[Read the confinement domain in full](./intake-confinement.md)

## results

Immutable UTF-8 observations retained by one run's briefing. Model-facing references select data before an ordinary action proposal reaches Commission admission; they never grant an action, carry authority, execute expressions, or stand in for verified evidence.

<DomainGraph data={domainGraph2} title="results" />

[Read the results domain in full](./intake-results.md)

## Routing

An intent as given, the references extracted from its text, the protocol the router proposes for it, and the slice run that works the intent until it is blocked. A pick is a proposal, never authority.

<DomainGraph data={domainGraph3} title="Routing" />

[Read the Routing domain in full](./intake-routing.md)
